name: jetson-sensevoice
description: Jetson Orin: SenseVoice offline ASR via a standalone TensorRT engine (fp16, activation-rescaled so Chinese activations stay fp16-safe; zh/en/ja/ko/yue). ASR-only transcription profile (no TTS) — SenseVoice encoder+CTC serves the offline /asr path. Validated on Orin Nano (TRT 10.4). asr_max_slots=8 is an ADMISSION ceiling, not parallelism: the backend holds one execution context and serializes on its own lock, so callers past the first queue instead of taking a 429. It costs no VRAM (no extra contexts) and trades 429s for queueing latency.
